page_title: Best GIF maker, recorder, converter, editor app – Gifox for Mac 🦊

summary.name: Gifox
summary.one_liner: Gifox is a Mac app for recording the screen, converting videos and image sequences, editing, and compressing them into animated GIFs.
use_cases: Recording a part of the screen or a single app window as a GIF
Converting a video or image sequence into a GIF
Trimming, cropping, or rearranging recorded clips
Compressing GIFs to a smaller file size
Sharing GIFs to Dropbox, Google Drive, or Imgur
Creating GIFs to show bugs or explain ideas to a team
summary.what_it_does: Gifox records a custom screen area or snaps to a window to capture app activity as GIF. It can import videos and image sequences and convert them to GIFs, which can be dragged into other apps. A built-in editor lets users crop, cut, trim, re-arrange, and re-export clips. Capture options include cursor, mouse clicks, keyboard input, window shadow, and desktop picture. Its compression settings cover playback, colors, resizing, and dithering, and it can upload to Dropbox, Google Drive, or Imgur.
notable: Window-snap mode for pixel-perfect recordings of any app
Compression controls for playback, colors, resizing, and dithering
Direct sharing to Dropbox, Google Drive, and Imgur
caveats: Mac only; no Windows or Linux version named on the page
